# Vidmark 1.4.1
- Shows the saved AI provider and model in the sidebar; click it to open Settings. - Consolidates provider and model preferences in Settings and removes the Build tab. Start builds from the course overview. - Detects signed-in Codex and Claude Code CLIs and supports automatic model selection without a hard-coded model catalog. - Adds read-only question fact-checking with evidence and visible review status. - Supports reading-based courses, course-specific exams, and optional chapter videos. - Protects course edits and transcripts from stale or cancelled agent writes, and preserves complete question banks and review history when sharing. - Adds local debug controls and improves agent cancellation, research validation, and preference saving.

# Vidmark 1.3.3
- Stops local services when the native app crashes or is force-quit. - Requires the native app's active unlock session before a bundled service can start. - Cleans up surviving services from older releases at launch. - Ignores expected cancelled page loads during lock and unlock. - Opens the workspace only after its own services confirm readiness; port conflicts stop startup.

# Vidmark 1.3.2
- Keeps Vidmark locked if authentication finishes after a sleep or lock event. - Discards pending workspace and notification responses from a previous unlocked session. - Requires authentication before changing the unlock method and handles malformed PIN settings through Mac authentication recovery. - Preserves notification destinations until Vidmark is unlocked. - Waits for local services to stop before reopening the workspace. - Explains how to unlock Vidmark when Claude Desktop cannot connect.
